# Game Idea: Falling Blocks Escape

- **Genre:** Endless arcade
- **Controls:** Left/Right arrow keys (or A/D) to move a player square horizontally.
- **Mechanic:** Blocks of varying width spawn at random positions at the top of the canvas and fall down, accelerating over time.
- **Objective:** Survive as long as possible, gaining points for each block that passes the bottom.
- **Lose Condition:** The game ends when a falling block collides with the player square or the player is pushed off the left/right edges.

1: // Simple endless arcade based on IDEA.md
2: (() => {
3: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Audio setup
7:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
8:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
9:   function playTone(freq, duration, type='sine') {
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.type = type;
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.connect(gain);
15:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
18:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration/1000);
19:     osc.start();
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration/1000);
21:   }
22:   function playCollision() { playTone(150, 200, 'triangle'); }
23:   function playScore() { playTone(600, 80, 'sawtooth'); }
24:   function playGameOver() { playTone(80, 500, 'square'); }
25: 
26:   // Helper to draw rounded rectangles
27:   function drawRoundedRect(x, y, w, h, r, style) {
28:     ctx.beginPath();
29:     ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
30:     ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
31:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
32:     ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
33:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
34:     ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
35:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
36:     ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
37:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
38:     ctx.closePath();
39:     ctx.fillStyle = style;
40:     ctx.fill();
41:   }
42:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = 400;
43:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = 600;
44: 
45:   // Player (rounded square)
46:   const player = { x: WIDTH / 2 - 15, y: HEIGHT - 30, w: 30, h: 30, speed: 4, dx: 0 };
47: 
48:   // Falling blocks
49:   const blocks = [];
50:   // Particle effects
51:   const particles = [];
52:   let blockTimer = 0;
53:   let blockInterval = 1500; // spawn rate (ms)
54:   let lastTime = 0;
55:   let speedY = 2;          // falling speed, accelerates
56:   let score = 0;
57:   let gameOver = false;
58: 
59: 
60:   // Input handling
61:   const keys = {};
62:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = true; if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = true; });
63:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = false; if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = false; });
64: 
65:   // Unlock audio on first interaction
66:   function unlockAudio(){ if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); }
67:   window.addEventListener('click', unlockAudio, {once:true});
68:   window.addEventListener('keydown', unlockAudio, {once:true});
69: 
70:   function spawnBlock() {
71:     const w = 30 + Math.random() * 70; // 30-100px
72:     const x = Math.random() * (WIDTH - w);
73:     blocks.push({ x, y: -20, w, h: 20 });
74:   }
75: 
76: function update(dt) {
77:     // player movement
78:     player.dx = 0;
79:     if (keys.left) player.dx = -player.speed;
80:     if (keys.right) player.dx = player.speed;
81:     player.x += player.dx;
82:     // keep within canvas
83:     if (player.x < 0) player.x = 0;
84:     if (player.x + player.w > WIDTH) player.x = WIDTH - player.w;
85: 
86:     // blocks spawning and movement
87:     blockTimer += dt;
88:     if (blockTimer > blockInterval) {
89:       spawnBlock();
90:       blockTimer = 0;
91:       if (blockInterval > 400) blockInterval -= 20;
92:       speedY += 0.02;
93:     }
94:     for (let i = blocks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const b = blocks[i];
96:       b.y += speedY;
97:       // collision with player
98:       if (b.y + b.h > player.y && b.y < player.y + player.h && b.x < player.x + player.w && b.x + b.w > player.x) {
99:         playCollision();
100:         gameOver = true;
101:         playGameOver();
102:       }
103:       // passed bottom – create burst and score
104: if (b.y > HEIGHT) {
105:           // create simple particle burst
106:           for (let j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
107:             particles.push({
108:               x: b.x + b.w / 2,
109:               y: HEIGHT,
110:               r: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
111:               vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
112:               vy: -Math.random() * 2 - 1,
113:               alpha: 1,
114:               color: '#ff3b30'
115:             });
116:           }
117:           blocks.splice(i, 1);
118:           score++;
119:           playScore();
120:         }
121:         blocks.splice(i, 1);
122:         score++;
123:       }
124:     }
125: 
126:     // update particles
127:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
128:       const p = particles[i];
129:       p.x += p.vx;
130:       p.y += p.vy;
131:       p.vy += 0.05; // gravity
132:       p.alpha -= 0.02;
133:       if (p.alpha <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
134:     }
135:   }
136: 
137:   function draw() {
138:     // background gradient
139:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
140:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#222');
141:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
142:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
143:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
144: 
145:     // particles
146:     particles.forEach(p => {
147:       ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
148:       ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;
149:       ctx.beginPath();
150:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
151:       ctx.fill();
152:     });
153:     ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
154: 
155:     // player (rounded)
156:     drawRoundedRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h, 6, '#0a84ff');
157:     // blocks (rounded)
158:     blocks.forEach(b => drawRoundedRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4, '#ff3b30'));
159:     // score
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
161:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
162:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
163:     // game over overlay
164:     if (gameOver) {
165:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
166:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
167:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
168:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
169:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
170:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2);
171:     }
172:   }
173: 
174:   function loop(timestamp) {
175:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
176:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
177:     lastTime = timestamp;
178:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
179:     draw();
180:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
181:   }
182: 
183:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
184: })();

(End of file - total 184 lines)
</content>
